intent: Establish as-built room dimensions and wall condition for level 2, room 204 ahead of the partition rework quote.

assurance.summary: Room dimensions to ±20 mm at 95%; wall verticality to ±0.5 deg; every dimension traceable to evidence.

requiredEvidence.description: Full visual coverage of all six room surfaces with overlap for registration.
Wall surface condition on all elevations, unobstructed where possible.

steps.title: Place the scale bar
steps.instructions: Place the 1 m scale bar flat on the floor near the room center, clear of furniture shadow.

steps.title: Video sweep of the room
steps.instructions: Walk the room perimeter at a slow, steady pace keeping all surfaces in frame; pause 2 s at each corner.

steps.title: Tape-measure the room width (fallback)
steps.instructions: If depth capture quality is insufficient, measure room width at floor level with the tape and photograph the tape reading.

referenceControls.description: Certified 1 m aluminium scale bar with cm graduations.
